text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-gateway | alert=HTTP_5xx_rate | rate=8.6% over 5m | region=us-west1

anya: pinging oncall, seeing elevated 5xx from edge -> gateway, paging now. Anyone oncall?

lee: I'm oncall, acked incident in PD. Checking dashboard.

omar: seeing spike across hosts, 502 dominant, spikes correspond to batch queue growth. Logs show 'kv_cache_miss' noise.

sophie: @lee can you toggle fallback-route to model-variant-smaller? that might reduce latencies and avoid retries.

lee: on it. switching routing policy to 'fallback:smaller' for prod-us-west1

incident-bot: Routing policy change submitted: /routing set fallback smaller --region us-west1

anya: also increasing per-host concurrency to 16 on the canary nodes to drain queue.

omar: small note — increased 502s coincide with a burst of long-context requests (seq ~4096). maybe KV cache thrash.

lee: confirmed, applied fallback. starting gradual canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

sophie: running curl check against gateway now:

```
curl -s -X POST https://gw-us-west1.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"xlarge","input":"hello"}' -v
```

omar: logs show connection resets from sidecar to model-worker on nodes 12-15. Restarting sidecar on node-12.

lee: ack. I'm doing rolling restart on sidecar pool for nodes 10-20. ETA ~4m

anya: customer-impact: observed 1200 requests/min failing; top affected customers: cust-a, cust-b. Reached support runbook.

sophie: sending note to support channel and scheduling incident bridge.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by lee. Escalation suppressed.

omar: after restart, 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% — still elevated but trending down.

lee: ramping canary to 50%. monitor for error regression.

anya: I'm opening a ticket to investigate KV cache eviction thresholds and batching window. tagging infra-ml.

sophie: can we enable prefix/KV cache warmup on the heavy endpoints? Might help.

omar: added cache_warmup flag to route config for customers cust-a and cust-b.

lee: error rate stable at 0.9% for 10m. I'll keep oncall until fully resolved.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: auto-close check scheduled in 30m if error rate stays <1%.

anya: thanks team. postmortem owners: omar (root cause) + sophie (mitigation + runbook updates). I'll create postmortem doc.

sophie: small follow-ups: add circuit-breaker alerts for sidecar conn resets, improve auto-retry backoff for long-context requests.

lee: resolved for now; leaving note for PD to close if no regressions.

pagerduty: Incident resolved by lee.

anya: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
